description: This file contains the Persian (ps) translation (localization) for the Select2 4.0.6-rc.1 JavaScript plugin. It provides localized strings for error messages and interface prompts used within Select2.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading of results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to enter more characters when input is below minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while additional results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching is in progress.
